Witness the FUTURE of Indian cricket and sports!
Soar above the stunning Rajgir International Cricket Stadium and Sports Complex in breathtaking 4K drone footage! This architectural marvel, nestled in the historic city of Rajgir, Bihar, is set to become India’s next iconic sports destination. From its world-class cricket ground to cutting-edge facilities, discover why this complex is making headlines!
In This Video:
Bird’s-Eye View of the state-of-the-art cricket stadium.
Exclusive Drone Shots of the massive sports complex, training centers, and lush surroundings.
